standardsSnapshot.message:
Automatically generate MD files for PRs (#245)

For PRs that use branches in the upstream repo, we can automatically
generate the markdown files and add a commit to the PR with the change,
so that users can just directly edit the json file in the github UI.

For forked PRs we can't do that, and for PRs that already update the
markdown files, we don't clobber their changes; instead just validate.
